Design Your Future at PVH
Store Manager, Calvin Klein - Cambridge (Mat Cover)
Calvin Klein is a global lifestyle brand that exemplifies bold, progressive ideals and a seductive, and often minimal, aesthetic. We seek to thrill and inspire our audience while using provocative imagery and striking designs to ignite the senses.
After nearly 50 years, Calvin Klein continues to be a cultural catalyst across the globe by embracing tension, sparking ideas and creating unforeseen realities. We believe in a culture that provokes discovery and brave thinking. We strive to make a positive impact on the world. We inspire passion in our people. We embody authenticity and embrace individuality.
Founded in 1968 by Calvin Klein and his business partner Barry Schwartz, we have built our reputation as a leader in American fashion through our clean aesthetic and innovative designs. Global retail sales of Calvin Klein brand products exceeded $8 billion in 2015 and were distributed in [over] 110 countries. Calvin Klein employs over 10,000 associates globally. We were acquired by PVH Corp. in 2003.
About THE ROLE
Our stores are the life and soul of our business.  They act as our main touch points with our ever evolving consumer base. As the world of retail evolves, we, as a business, believe that for all other parts of the chain to work, our stores must set the tone of what our two brands are all about.  Irrespective of where our consumers eventually make a purchase, our stores, are always a window to our great brands.  As a result our locations are paramount, the first class experience must be a given and our in-store standards should never be questionable.
To deliver this, we strive to hire the individuals who live and breathe the values of our business; who are obsessed with delivering great service to our customers and who truly believe that to remain relevant in today’s world, we must be nimble and adapt to change and evolution.
The Assistant Manager plays a key role in achieving these standards, they lead by example, embrace our entrepreneurial spirit and inspire their teams through their passion and belief in our brands.
Responsibilities include:
• Leading the store teams to generate sales, profit, minimise losses, and create the best possible customer experience whilst ensuring the store is visually distinctive and impeccably maintained.
• Identify opportunities to grow the business and improve performance through collaborating with others.
• Maintain corporate visual merchandising directives and standards for sales floor and back room.
• Work alongside the visual merchandising team to ensure that there is clear communication and understanding between VM and store teams.
• Partner with store management team to build on business opportunities and achieve company standards and objectives
• Focus staff on the importance of quality of relationships with internal and external customers. Ensure accountability of staff in building a repeat customer base by providing all customers with unparalleled spirited service.
• Complete daily/weekly store walkthroughs; evaluate product performance, pricing, staff service levels and inventory levels.
• Communicate to the Store Manager what is driving sales and discuss any issues/priorities, in order to develop strategies to maximise business. Ensure they are weekly visual presentation action plans.
• Analyse store level reports and create action plans to improve results.
• Assist with the manpower planning, identification, recruitment, interviewing and hiring processes; Recruit store personnel with a broad range of perspectives, experiences and backgrounds.
• Work with the Store Manager to build bench strength for key positions, including possible successors.
• Participate in weekly management meetings alongside other staff meetings.
• Clearly communicate to staff: store and individual sales goals and other key performance expectations; sales results and provide guidance on what is needed to improve performance.
• Providing a great customer journey and achieving exemplary mystery shop results.
About YOU
• You'll have a minimum of 4 years of progressive retail experience.
• You'll have a minimum 2 years store management experience in the service or retail industry.
• You'll be an effective communicator with the ability to build relationships with ease.
• You'll be a team player who recognises and celebrates the contributions and achievements of others.
• You'll be confident in giving feedback that promotes positive behavioral change.
• You'll have strong people management skills with the ability to resolve conflict and unproductive disagreements.
• You will work well with change, being able to quickly adapt and work with pace.
• You will be energetic and authentic showing a clear presence on the shop floor.
About WHAT WE OFFER
At PVH, we understand that the success of our organisation is directly related to our hardworking and dedicated associates who contribute their time and talents to help make our Company the success it is. That is why we are committed to providing a competitive and comprehensive benefits program that offers the protection, peace of mind and flexibility designed to support our associates – both at home and at work.
PVH Europe and our brands, TOMMY HILFIGER and CALVIN KLEIN, are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse community of associates with a strong sense of belonging. We believe we are bettered by all forms of diversity, and take pride in working with top talent from every walk of life and corner of the world. As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.
​About the Role:
The CrowdStrike Intelligence team is looking for a Senior Software Engineer to work on our dedicated engineering team, building processing pipelines, information storage systems and presentation layers in support of our world-class team of analysts and researchers.
The collection, processing, and exploration of information at a large scale is at the core of the Intelligence mission at CrowdStrike. The Intelligence Automation team is responsible for prototyping, building and operating the systems that make up our Intelligence pipeline, and we'd like you to join us!
You will use your deep experience in scalable, distributed architectures to design flexible data integration and processing systems in a fast-paced Intelligence environment. In this environment, requirements sometimes shift rapidly, and projects can live anything from weeks to years depending on changes in the surrounding ecosystem. You will be responsible for all aspects of the software you design, from initial design, over hands-on prototyping, overseeing and taking an active part in the actual implementation, down to deployment to production, and ensuring smooth operations. In addition, you will be responsible for proper documentation and training of customers of the systems you design. You will interact regularly with your internal customers to gather requirements, solicit feedback, and validate your results. We are agnostic when it comes to technology stacks, and you will be free to pick the technologies and tools that best fit the purpose at any given time, based on your previous exposure to a wide variety of technologies such as programming languages, database systems, network protocols, queuing and messaging systems, etc.
As a remote employee on a team distributed across various time zones, you will not have direct access to all of your co-workers at every point of time, so your ability to work unsupervised, communicate asynchronously, and take the initiative in maintaining lines of communication is crucial. In addition, we are looking for someone who would like to be part of a team who are passionate about their work and go the extra mile to exceed expectations. We love enthusiastic individuals who bring a positive attitude to their work and really care about what they produce for our internal customers.
What You’ll Do:
•
Integrate into the Intelligence team and gather requirements from Intelligence Analysts and Technical Analysts as internal customers
•
Assume responsibility for the long-term maintenance of both, new and legacy systems
•
Autonomously develop requirements based on anything from vague mission statements to very detailed technical specifications
•
Develop systems and autonomously make choices about implementation details, as well as the right balance between rapid development, scalability, and performance
What You’ll Need:
•
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent academic/work experience
•
Demonstrated, multi-year experience in software engineering
•
Experience in developing scalable, distributed and production-grade services
•
Proficiency in Linux and containers
•
Proficiency in hands-on coding in multiple programming languages
•
Knowledge of SQL and No-SQL database systems
•
Knowledge of cloud technologies
•
Ability to maintain and improve existing Go and Python code bases
•
Ability to communicate technical detail in a simple, top-down manner to management, customers, and peers
•
Ability to independently  make sound, justifiable decisions and take action
•
Ability to plan, organize and prioritize work independently and meet deadlines
•
Ability to work on a geographically distributed and diverse team
•
Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
Bonus Points
•
Familiarity with the AWS or GCP cloud ecosystem (e.g. EC2, S3, VPC, ECS)
•
Experience developing Web UIs, e.g. Single-Page-Applications (SPA)
•
Experience creating scalable and well-documented HTTP APIs
•
Experience with malware analysis or software reverse engineering

Offensive information security experience, e.g. from capture-the-flag (CTF) competitions

To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
Group/Division
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The SPTS division provides advanced wafer processing solutions—including etch, deposition and vapor-based technologies—designed for R&D through high-volume production. With a global presence and strong customer support network, SPTS helps manufacturers across industries improve performance, yield and cost-efficiency. It also offers comprehensive service and spare parts through a worldwide network of service centers and qualified local agents.
What You'll Do
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
Part of the KLA Engineering division, the Platform Engineering and Development Group delivers automation solutions that integrate KLA process systems into semiconductor fabs worldwide.
This new role offers exposure to emerging technologies and varied projects, including international travel to support product installations and customer applications.
We are seeking an experienced multidisciplinary engineer with strong electrical, electronic, and mechanical knowledge to support system operation, integration, calibration, diagnostics, Alpha/Beta systems, and retrofit activities, while providing design feedback and improvement recommendations.
You will work with specialists on equipment design and integration, delivering to tight deadlines in a highly regulated industry.
We will seek to give as much notice as possible for travel, but trips may be at very short notice and can be for up to 4 weeks at a time.  One-week visits would be more typical.  Weekend travel to site maybe required.
KLA will provide travel expenses and accommodation, in line with our travel policy.
Key Responsibilities:
• Maintain development and continuous improvement of Platform semiconductor handling hardware.
• Support new hardware designs through build, integration, fault-finding, and PLC readiness.
• Lead installation, commissioning, and technical resolution of new products at customer sites.
• Travel internationally up to 50% to support critical customer engagements and resolve complex technical issues.
• Translate customer requirements and factory learnings into business-critical design improvements.
• Shape technical responses to customer specifications and system-level requirements.
• Define robust design specifications that align customer needs, product strategy, and engineering standards.
• Champion serviceability, reliability, and maintainability in new product designs.
• Ensure machine performance and compliance against relevant international standards.
• Produce clear technical reports that support decision-making, risk management, and customer confidence.
• Lead hardware test strategy, validation planning, and performance characterisation.
• Produce support documentation and procedures.
• Influence cross-functional teams to optimise hardware performance, reliability, and customer readiness.
Key Skills Required
• A flexible work ethic and ability to use initiative
• Excellent analytical and fault-finding skills
• Able to work both autonomously and as part of a team
• Well organised – You’ll work autonomously, often in different time zones and be trusted to work without assistance or management.
• Composed – You’ll thrive in the sometimes-pressurised environment of semiconductor manufacturing environments.
• Able to demonstrate strong Communication skills – You’ll enjoy establishing and maintaining good working relationships with both customers and colleagues.
• Languages: Fluent English (Both written and spoken)
• Driving license to be able to travel throughout Europe
Occasional domestic and international travel, including to the United States, may be required as part of this role
What we will offer you?
Our benefits package includes:
Annual leave starting at 25 days (plus bank holidays), contributory pension scheme, cash health plan, cycle to work scheme, global bonus plan, share scheme, rewards scheme, life assurance, generous shift allowance and overtime premiums.
Minimum Qualifications
Qualifications and Experience:
• Minimum HNC Electrical/ Mechanical/ Mechatronics.
• Experience working in manufacturing role with an eye for continuous improvement
• Experience in a customer facing role would be desirable
• An understanding of machinery safety and safe working practices.
• Experience in diagnosing faults with an analytical mind
• AutoCAD Electrical or equivalent experience 3D CAD experience is desired
• Good understanding of MS Office applications.
About KLA
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.

This role is ideal for an experienced insurance professional with a strong background in commercial client servicing, renewals, and placement support. You will play a key role in supporting Client and Account Executives, helping to shape placement strategy, manage mid-term adjustments, and deliver an outstanding level of service to a diverse portfolio of commercial clients.
At Marsh Commercial, we are committed to helping our people grow and develop. We invest in learning, development, and career progression, and foster a collaborative culture where colleagues are supported to succeed.
What you can expect
•
The opportunity to join a growing, high-performing team serving a broad range of commercial clients
•
A collaborative environment focused on best practice, client service excellence, and technical expertise
•
The chance to build trusted relationships with clients, insurers, and colleagues across Marsh
•
Strong training, support, and development opportunities with clear career progression
In this role, you will:
•
Support Client Executives with placement strategy for insurance renewals and mid-term changes to risk
•
Request, review, and interpret underwriting information on behalf of commercial clients
•
Prepare and submit accurate market presentations and slips in collaboration with Client Executives and the Placement Team
•
Use Marsh online trading systems to collate and negotiate renewal terms with existing and prospective insurers
•
Work closely with internal teams to prepare client reports for renewals
•
Produce and/or request insurer documentation as required
•
Review and comment on indemnity and insurance clauses
•
Act as a senior point of contact for more complex queries, offering support and guidance where appropriate
•
Contribute to a high-performing, client-focused culture and support the development of colleagues where needed
What we’re looking for:
•
Proven experience managing the full renewal process for commercial insurance programmes
•
Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities
•
Good awareness of clients’ businesses, insurance requirements, and service expectations
•
Experience handling more complex client needs and supporting technical or service-related queries
What makes you stand out:
•
A confident, client-facing approach with the ability to build strong relationships
•
Calm under pressure and able to adapt flexibly when needed
•
Strong technical knowledge and confidence supporting more complex accounts
•
Cert CII qualified, with progress toward ACII desirable
Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age background, civil partnership status, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments in accordance with applicable law to any candidate with a disability to allow them to fully participate in the recruitment process. If you have a disability that may require reasonable adjustments, please contact us at reasonableaccommodations@marsh.com.
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

Digital Foundations/Cloud Advisory - Architecture – Associate Manager - London
Location: London
Salary: Competitive salary and package (Depending on level of experience)
Level: 8 & 9 – Senior Consultant & Associate Manager
As a team:
Working at the forefront of multiple industries, our architecture team leads the design and delivery of some of the largest, most complex, and highest-profile technology transformations in the world. We bring together deep technology, business, and industry expertise to set direction, solve critical challenges, and deliver architectures that scale, endure, and create real impact.
In our team, you will:
• Lead and shape conversations with clients, defining and driving solutions to real-world problems through a blend of architecture and engineering across public, private, and hybrid cloud environments
• Set the technical direction, influencing decisions at scale while being backed by industry-leading training, certifications, and structured coaching and mentoring programmes.
As a Consultant, you will:
• Drive Strategy & Modernization: Partner directly with clients and where necessary our partner ecosystem to translate business goals into technical requirements, defining target operating models and modernization roadmaps.
• Optimize Value: Drive system performance and cost-efficiency, advising clients on Cloud Economics (FinOps), sustainability (Green Software), and resilience ensuring high performance, observable architectures especially where GenAI and Agentic play a role.
• Champion system performance, resilience, and efficiency: Proactively identifying and addressing consumption and scalability challenges.  Champion full stack observability using modern full stack observability, SRE and AIOps.
• Ensure Robustness & Security: Own the design of enterprise-wide applications that are highly available, fault-tolerant, and secure zero trust identity and access management (never trust, always verify).
• Manage & Mentor: Lead teams of architects and engineers, providing technical coaching, career counselling, performance management, and coaching to elevate technical excellence.
• Explore Emerging Agentic Architectures: Bring a genuine interest in Agentic AI and its potential to reshape how systems are designed and operated. Whether through client engagements, personal projects, prototype development, training, or independent research, demonstrate a commitment to building your knowledge and staying ahead of this fast-evolving area of technology.
•
• Strategic Architecture: A strong command of software architecture with the ability to link technical decisions to business outcomes (e.g., TCO, speed to market).
• Cloud & Integration Fluency: Proven experience across one or more cloud platforms  (AWS, Azure, GCP, IBM), including  PaaS and API gateway, IaaS including but not limited to network design, connectivity patterns, zero trust IAM, compute, storage backup, HA and DR strategies, container platforms and orchestration and iPaaS
• Embrace the Agentic Future: Demonstrate a passion for Agentic AI and the opportunities it creates for transforming technology and business operations. You may already have experience contributing to agentic solutions, or you may be actively developing your skills.  We are looking for architects who are curious about this rapidly evolving field and eager to help clients navigate the journey towards increasingly intelligent, autonomous, and AI-driven systems.
• Hybrid and multi-cloud : Skilled in hybrid architectures and able to demonstrate where legacy meets cloud
• Operational Excellence: A solid understanding of non-functional requirements and the ability to translate them into robust architectural decisions for critical infrastructure.
• Advisory Skills: The ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders ("Storytelling") and manage senior client relationships.
What will set you apart:
• Engineering/Development : Demonstrated experience working close to engineering and teams, ensuring realistic delivery expectations.
• Developer Repo Contributions : Showcase during interview personal or open-source work, prototypes, accelerators, or reference architectures so that during interview the repo artefacts can be used explain their decisions through architecture diagrams, ADRs, and code samples.
• Eligibility to obtain security clearance
About Accenture
Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Our broad range of services, solutions and assets across Strategy & Consulting, Technology, Operations, Industry X and Song, together with our culture of shared success and commitment to creating 360° value, enable us to help our clients reinvent and build trusted, lasting relationships. We measure our success by the 360° value we create for our clients, each other, our shareholders, partners and communities.

The role will involve the following main activities and responsibilities (working within a team which comprises on each case, the appointed IP, case manager plus others on larger cases):
• Managing a portfolio of corporate insolvency cases from appointment through to closure, under appropriate supervision.
• Progressing cases proactively, managing priorities effectively and keeping the team informed of developments.
• Agreeing weekly work priorities with the manager.
• Identifying and escalating technical, commercial and risk matters to managers and officeholders at an early stage.
• Carrying out work efficiently and in compliance with relevant legal and statutory obligations and the Firm's procedures.

• Processing case transactions, including payments, receipts and journals, using IPS Cloud.
• Preparing VAT returns and supporting VAT, PAYE and corporation tax compliance requirements in correspondence with specialist tax teams, where required.

• Supporting asset realisations, including liaising with agents and solicitors.
• Assisting with the marketing process when a business is offered for sale.
• Understanding the requirements of Statement of Insolvency Practice 9, record time appropriately and produce SIP 9 reports following training on the Firm's bespoke time-recording system.

• Supporting the development of junior team members through coaching, guidance and knowledge sharing.
• Assisting with the management, storage and archiving of company records and case documentation.

• Experience of corporate insolvency work, particularly Administrations and/or CVLs.
• Experience using IPS Cloud (or equivalent insolvency software) and Microsoft Office applications.
• CPI and/or an accounting qualification (desirable but not essential).
• Good working knowledge of insolvency legislation and an awareness of relevant current case law.
• Experience of preparing statutory reports, notices and other insolvency documentation.
• Experience with dealing with creditor claims, employee claims, investigations and asset realisations.
• Able to prepare estimated outcome statements, including a Prescribed Part calculation, where applicable.
• Experience of maintaining case control schedules, including matters such as retention of title claims and debtor collections.
• Experience of managing delegated aspects of insolvency cases with appropriate supervision.
• Experience of liaising with directors, creditors, agents, solicitors and other key stakeholders.
• Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work to tight deadlines.
• Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality work.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
• A proactive approach to learning, personal development and continuous improvement.
• An interest in supporting business development and networking activities.

Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Job Title: Mortgage Adviser – SPF Private Clients (part of Howden)
Location: London
Team: Employee Benefits
About the Opportunity
This is an exciting time to join our rapidly expanding Employee Benefits team, a newly developed and fast‑paced area of our business. As we scale, we are building a team of talented advisers who want to be part of something evolving, energised, and full of opportunity.
We are seeking a Mortgage Adviser to deliver high‑quality, regulated mortgage advice to both new and existing clients. All leads are provided, allowing you to focus on what you do best—advising clients and delivering outstanding outcomes. Previous experience within an employee benefits or similar financial services team is highly desirable.
This role sits within SPF Private Clients, now proudly part of the Howden Group, giving you the unique advantage of working within a specialist, client‑focused brokerage while benefiting from the scale, stability, and culture of one of the world’s largest insurance groups.
You will play a key role in ensuring accurate, compliant recommendations and first‑class service throughout the entire mortgage journey, with responsibility for upholding FCA requirements—including Consumer Duty—to ensure fair treatment and good outcomes for all customers.
Key Responsibilities
Client Advice & Service
• Provide clear, professional mortgage advice to prospective and existing clients.
• Gather and assess client information to complete full needs analyses.
• Prepare and present compliant and suitable recommendations and reports.
• Ensure consistent adherence to FCA requirements and company compliance policies.
• Accurately and promptly log all client interactions.
Business Development
• Collaborate with your Supervisor to deliver a business development plan aligned to company objectives.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, introducers, and relevant stakeholders.
• Regularly review client circumstances to identify ongoing advice opportunities.
• Represent SPF Private Clients professionally at all times.
Compliance & Record Keeping
• Follow company procedures when submitting business and managing client files.
• Ensure all administrative tasks meet required record‑keeping and file‑quality standards.
• Complete remedial actions promptly and within set timescales.
• Maintain accurate data within internal systems.
• Demonstrate ongoing competence through monitoring and assessments as required.
Training & Development
• Obtain and maintain required qualifications to act as a Registered Mortgage Adviser.
• Complete CPD in line with company policy.
• Participate in training programmes and work with your Supervisor to address development needs.
• Keep up to date with industry practices and regulatory changes.
Qualifications & Skills Required
• CeMAP (Certificate in Mortgage Advice and Practice) or equivalent.
• Knowledge of relevant FCA sourcebooks, including:
• PRIN (Principles for Business)
• COCON (Code of Conduct)
• FIT (Fit and Proper Test)
• TC (Training and Competence)
• GEN (General Provisions)
• DISP (Dispute Resolution)
• MCOBS (Business Standards)
• Awareness of financial crime and AML requirements (SYSC, JMLSG guidance, Bribery Act).
• Strong communication skills suitable for a wide range of client situations.
• Ability to assess information, apply regulatory standards, and work within clear processes.
• Experience within an employee benefits or similar financial services environment is advantageous.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
•
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
•
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
•
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs.  Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.
If you're excited by this role but have some doubts about whether it’s the right fit for you, send us your application – if your profile fits the role’s criteria, we will be in touch to assist in helping to get you set up with any reasonable adjustments you may require.
*Not all positions can accommodate changes to working hours or locations. Reach out to your Recruitment Partner if you want to know more.

Job Description:
Leonardo offers a range of Apprenticeships across a variety of STEM and business routes, offering paid training, coupled with on the job learning that enables you to gain practical skills, experience and knowledge that sets up the best start to your career. We offer competitive entry salaries and fully support your academic learning through to qualifications, with salary increases as you progress.
We support helping you settle into your new location ensuring you are familiar with the team and have a warm welcome from day 1. There is a member of our Apprentice team at each site, helping you progress, ensuring your study time is protected, enabling access to digital learning as well as opportunities to get involved with the local community and STEM projects, enhance many aspects of each programme.
The Apprenticeship:
Our Aerospace Manufacturing Composites apprenticeship is suited for those who are interested in the practical (hands-on) elements of engineering.
Over the 3 years on scheme, you will have the opportunity to rotate across a number of placements, based within the Dynamics Composites Centre (DCC) department, which is the area that manufactures blades for many of the Leonardo Helicopter aircraft, including military, civil and VVIP aircraft. The ultimate aim of the scheme is to move you into a final placement area based on the skills displayed during the apprenticeship.
The apprenticeship will start with an Induction into Leonardo, followed by a Yeovil College Induction to ensure that apprenticeship requirements and expectations are fully established.
You will combine your time between Yeovil College and work placements at Leonardo Helicopters, increasing your work placements as you move through the years.
Throughout the apprenticeship, apprentices may be placed in some or all of the following departmental areas within DCC:
• Clean room: The manufacture of the majority of the blade products is completed in this area (including the blade spar, which is the main structural component of the blade)
• Repairs: The area that deals with the in-service products, the blades come in from working aircraft that require maintenance or repair (this can be from general wear and tear or from battle damage)
• Non Destructive Test (NDT): The testing of the blades through the use of non-destructive test methods is covered in this placement
• Inspection: The Inspection of completed processes/tasks against the requirements of the Leonardo Engineering standards
• DCC Quality Control (QC): This department is responsible for the audit of DCC process compliance, and the Investigation of any product/process non-compliance that may occur.
During your apprenticeship, you will:
• Grow your knowledge of an engineering business.
• Develop practical skills in engineering and understanding key processes and technologies.
• Support early careers activities - our apprentices have the opportunity to work as STEM ambassadors in schools, colleges and universities
Each Apprentice on this route will need to complete an End Point Assessment as defined in the Apprenticeship Standard, this will take place in the final months of the program.
What you'll bring:
Qualifications
You must have (as a minimum) the following qualifications:
• 4 GCSE grades 4 - 9 or grades A*- C or equivalent - Mandatory: English, Maths and Science. *Note – due to the course content, a higher tier C in Maths is recommended
Security Clearance
At Leonardo, many of our roles are subject to security and export control restrictions set by UK Government Security requirements and customer obligations.  As a result, and in line with the UK Government Baseline Personnel Security Standard (BPSS) requirements, all successful applicants will be asked to provide evidence of identity, eligibility to work in the UK, criminal record declaration information and employment and/or education history verification for the previous five years.
For staff operating in more sensitive posts, there is an additional range of personnel security controls referred to as National Security Vetting (NSV).  As part of this process, a range of factors may be considered, including an individual's background, travel history, nationality, previous nationalities held and other information relevant to the vetting assessment.
To be eligible for National Security Vetting at SC level, applicants will generally be expected to have continuously resided in the UK for the previous five years. For DV clearance, this is typically ten years.  In some circumstances, time spent overseas may be accepted, with additional overseas checks.  Additional vetting requirements may apply upon appointment.
For more information and guidance please visit: https://careers.uk.leonardo.com/gb/en/security-and-vetting
Why join us
At Leonardo, our people are at the heart of everything we do. We offer a comprehensive, company-funded benefits package that supports your wellbeing, career development, and work–life balance. Whether you're looking to grow professionally, care for your health, or plan for the future, we’re here to help you thrive.
• Time to Recharge: Enjoy generous leave with the opportunity to accrue up to 12 additional flexi-days each year.
• Secure your Future: Benefit from our award-winning pension scheme with up to 15% employer contribution.
• Your Wellbeing Matters: Free access to mental health support, financial advice, and employee-led networks championing inclusion and diversity (Enable, Pride, Equalise, Armed Forces, Carers, Wellbeing and Ethnicity).
• Rewarding Performance: All employees at management level and below are eligible for our bonus scheme.
• Never Stop Learning: Free access to 4,000+ online courses via Coursera and LinkedIn Learning.
• Refer a friend: Receive a financial reward through our referral programme.
• Tailored Perks: Spend up to £500 annually on flexible benefits including private healthcare, dental, family cover, tech & lifestyle discounts, gym memberships and more.
• Flexible working: Flexible hours with hybrid working options. For part time opportunities, please talk to us about what might be possible for this role.
For a full list of our company benefits please visit our website.

Looking for a role where you can influence underwriting decisions through catastrophe modelling and exposure analytics, while partnering with underwriters and senior stakeholders to drive profitable portfolio performance?
The Senior Catastrophe Analyst is responsible for delivering catastrophe modelling, exposure management and portfolio analytics across Markel International, providing data-driven insights that support underwriting decisions, risk management and strategic portfolio development.
What part will you play? If you’re looking for a place where you can make a meaningful difference, you’ve found it. The work we do at Markel gives people the confidence to move forward and seize opportunities, and you’ll find your fit amongst our global community of optimists and problem-solvers. We’re always pushing each other to go further because we believe that when we realize our potential, we can help others reach theirs.
Join us and play your part in something special!
The opportunity:
The International Portfolio Analytics (IPA) team at Markel is a dynamic, multi-functional group that operates with creativity, autonomy, and empowerment. Embedded within the underwriting business and represented in senior leadership forums, the team supports all divisions of Markel International. Its core focus lies in the key areas crucial to driving profitability and performance for a specialty lines insurer: Portfolio Management, Pricing Transformation, Advanced Analytics and Catastrophe & Exposure Management.
The Catastrophe and Exposure Management Team deliver a comprehensive suite of analytical services that support informed underwriting decisions and robust risk management practices. The team’s mission is to enable Markel International to achieve consistent underwriting profitability and superior financial outcomes by providing high-quality, data-driven analytical support across the business.
As part of the Catastrophe Modelling and Exposure Management team, you will be supporting Markel International with pre-underwriting analytics, class and entity level reporting, ad-hoc analysis to support underwriting decisions and view of risk development. The role may be required to work over a number of lines of business including both natural catastrophe and anthropogenic risks.
What you’ll be doing:
• Build and maintain a strong relationship with divisional underwriters.
• Provide ad hoc analytics for underwriting portfolio analysis and reporting for senior executives.
• Use third party catastrophe models and in-house tools for pre-underwriting analysis.
• Present results and ideas to senior stakeholders and underwriting teams.
• Collaborate closely with colleagues in other Markel offices and the wider portfolio analytics team.
• Liaise closely with outsourcing partners and model vendors.
• Assist in team projects and initiatives, such as view of risk development.
• Assist in producing reporting for both within the organization and for outside parties, including Lloyds and the PRA.
Our must-haves:
• Technical Expertise: Catastrophe modelling or aggregation management experience in the London market, with strong understanding of industry-standard models (Verisk preferred).
• Problem Solving: Strong appetite to think creatively and challenge modelling assumptions and processes, to improve the quality, timeliness and insights of analytics provided.
• Technical Skills: Excellent IT skills with good knowledge of SQL and/or python.
• Industry Best Practice: Proven experience with catastrophe management standards and portfolio level aggregation techniques.
• Collaboration: Experience of building and maintaining successful relationships with internal and external contacts.
• Project Management: The ability to balance multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
Who we are:
Markel Group (NYSE – MKL) a Fortune 500 company with over 60 offices in 20+ countries, is a holding company for insurance, reinsurance, specialist advisory, and investment operations around the world.
We’re all about people | We win together | We strive for better | We enjoy the everyday | We think further

• A great starting salary plus annual bonus & strong benefits package…
• 25 days paid holiday plus Bank Holidays, with the opportunity to buy/sell extra leave
• Fantastic company pension scheme, private medical and dental cover, life assurance, travel insurance cover, income protection, season ticket loan as well as other great benefits on offer
• There are countless opportunities to learn new skills and develop in your career and we can provide the support needed to do just that!

Markel celebrates the value of a diverse workforce that brings experience and expertise from a wide variety of backgrounds and life circumstances. wellington.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/externa.description_excerpt:
About Us
Wellington Management offers comprehensive investment management capabilities that span nearly all segments of the global capital markets. Our investment solutions, tailored to the unique return and risk objectives of institutional clients in more than 60 countries, draw on a robust body of proprietary research and a collaborative culture that encourages independent thought and healthy debate. As a private partnership, we believe our ownership structure fosters a long-term view that aligns our perspectives with those of our clients.
About the Role
THE COMPANY
Tracing our roots to 1928, Wellington Management Company, LLP is one of the world’s largest independent investment management firms. With US$1.3 trillion in assets under management, we serve as a trusted adviser to institutional clients and mutual fund sponsors in over 50 countries. Our innovative investment solutions are built on the strength of proprietary, independent research and span nearly all segments of the global capital markets, including equity, fixed income, multi-asset, and alternative strategies. As a private partnership whose sole business is investment management, our long-term views and interests are aligned with those of our clients. We are committed to attracting a talented and diverse workforce, and to fostering an open, collaborative culture of inclusivity because we believe multiple perspectives lead to more informed investment and business decisions. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome people with diverse life experiences, fresh ideas, and specialized subject-matter expertise.
THE POSITION
This role sits within the firm’s Enterprise Strategy Office, which reports into the CEO, and is primarily aligned with the Firm & Product Strategy function.  This function serves as the firm's center of excellence for industry and competitive insights, supporting strategic projects across the firm, and is responsible for product and fund development and product prioritization.
The Competitive Intelligence and Market Research Lead will play an important role in shaping Wellington’s product strategy and positioning. This individual will leverage competitive insights to inform product development, guide fund prioritization, and partner with product management and sales teams to optimize how our products are positioned in the marketplace. The ideal candidate will bring a passion for data-driven industry research, knowledge of the asset management industry and its key data providers such as eVestment, Broadridge and Morningstar, a collaborative working style, a commercial mindset, and a strong desire to grow and learn.
Key areas of responsibility include:
• Maintain a rich understanding of industry trends, competitor strategies, client needs, and regulatory developments across asset classes
• Own and manage Wellington’s relationships with industry research and data vendors.  Manage our portfolio of tools and data by monitoring new capabilities and recommending purchase and usage
• Broadly distribute market and competitor insights through the development of new management reporting as well as ad hoc communications
• Support critical management decision making through custom analysis and thought partnership
• Inform product development and fund prioritization through competitive intelligence and market analysis
• Develop frameworks and processes to support product launch decisions and ongoing prioritization
• Identify opportunities to scale and enhance Wellington’s product and fund platform
• Partner with Product Managers and Portfolio Advisors to develop compelling product and fund positioning informed by competitor knowledge
• Contribute to the development of next-generation talent within the CPS function through mentorship and apprenticeship
THE PERSON
• The ideal candidate will have:
• 6-12+ years of experience
• Knowledge of the asset management industry.  Likely including experience in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, product management, competitive intelligence and/or industry research
• Ability to translate complex strategic questions into specific and actionable analysis
• A commercial mindset and strong track record of collaborative leadership
• Proven ability to manage complex projects and deliver strategic insights
• Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders
• Comfort operating in a consensus-driven environment
• A passion for developing talent and fostering innovation

Author and revise SOPs, technical protocols, and reports while identifying opportunities to improve laboratory workflows, analytical reliability, and stability program execution.

• Designing evaluations, guardrails and monitoring approaches for agent reliability.

Essential
• Degree in computer science, artificial intelligence, machine learning, engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

• An understanding of reinforcement learning, preference optimisation or sequential decision-making.
• Some experience evaluating models or implementing ideas from machine-learning research.
Desirable

Epping: a varied hospital caseload
Epping supports its own clients as well as local practices, giving the team exposure to genuine emergencies and more complex cases. These include road traffic accidents, GDVs, haemabdomen, blocked bladders, foreign body ingestions, cystotomies and paralysis.
The team aims to investigate and manage cases in-house wherever clinically appropriate, giving you the opportunity to take ownership of your clinical decisions and follow patients through their treatment.
Harlow: help shape the next chapter
Our new Harlow hospital represents a significant investment in the future of Forest Vets. Facilities include five consultation rooms, two theatres, a dedicated dental area, CT, X-ray, endoscopy, a six-station preparation room, separate dog and cat wards, a cat-only consultation and waiting area, isolation facilities and an in-house laboratory, the facilities are in place to support an ambitious clinical offering. The next steps are about making the most of that potential: developing the caseload, strengthening the clinical team and continuing to build how the hospital works.
You'll be able to contribute your ideas and experience as the team develops its approach to clinical care, surgery and case management. For a vet who enjoys improving how things are done and wants to see the impact of their contribution, there is considerable scope to make a difference.
Clinical development and collaboration
Across Forest Vets, the wider clinical team includes certificate holders in medicine, small animal surgery, cardiology, dermatology and diagnostic imaging, including three medicine certificate holders and two imaging certificate holders.
You'll have opportunities to discuss challenging cases and learn from colleagues with different areas of expertise, while taking responsibility for your own clinical decisions.
You'll receive at least one dedicated surgery day each week. At Epping, this currently averages around six surgical cases per day, while the surgical caseload at Harlow continues to develop. You'll need to be confident with routine soft tissue surgery and comfortable managing emergency presentations.
The role also includes a dedicated inpatient shift each week, typically involving 10–12 hospitalised patients with dedicated nursing support. This gives you the opportunity to follow cases beyond the consultation room and develop your experience in ongoing patient management.
The practice currently refers spinal cases externally and will soon also refer ophthalmology cases as its current ophthalmology certificate holder moves on. There remains a strong appetite to investigate and treat cases in-house wherever clinically appropriate.
The role offers 40 hours per week, with a choice of two working patterns:
• Four-day compressed week: three 11-hour days, 8am–7pm, plus one shorter day, 8am–4.30pm.
• Five-day week: five eight-hour days, with a mixture of 8am–4.30pm and 11am–7pm shifts.
Admin time is built into the working day, with break arrangements varying by working pattern. There is no routine out-of-hours work. The current weekend rota is expected to reduce as the team grows too!
What we're looking for
• RCVS-registered Veterinary Surgeon with ideally around three to five years' UK experience, depending on clinical exposure and confidence.
• Previous hospital experience is essential.
• Confident performing routine soft tissue surgery and managing emergency presentations.
• Able to manage hospitalised patients and make sound clinical decisions in sole charge.
• Strong diagnostic reasoning and clinical judgement, with referral experience advantageous.
• Empathetic and compassionate when supporting clients through difficult or sensitive cases.
• Calm under pressure, collaborative and comfortable discussing challenging cases with colleagues.
• Motivated to develop clinically and contribute ideas to the continued development of Harlow hospital.

Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Job Description
Summary
Ares is seeking a Quantitative Product lead to help define and deliver the product strategy for quantitative investment technology across the firm's global investment platform.
The role sits within Investment Technology Product Management and serves as the product liaison to Ares' global quantitative teams, including Ares' Quantitative Research teams, recognizing that these teams have distinct investment objectives, research methods, tooling requirements, and coverage across a diverse universe of assets, funds, portfolios, and other securities.
In addition to supporting the quant groups directly, the role will act as a catalyst for extending relevant quantitative tools, techniques, data practices, and analytical capabilities into other Ares asset classes and business lines. The individual will identify where proven approaches can be adapted and scaled horizontally, helping embed the quant teams more deeply into the wider organization and increasing the contribution of these functions to investment decision-making across the firm.
The Quantitative Product lead will own product activities from workflow discovery and use-case definition through prioritization, solution design, delivery, adoption, and value realization. The role will assess the process, data, model, and application landscape; distinguish common capabilities from strategy-specific requirements; and determine when solutions should be built, bought, reused, or adapted across teams.
The successful candidate will combine strong product judgment with sufficient quantitative and technical depth to understand models, data dependencies, investment context, and to work effectively with quantitative engineers and investment professionals.
Primary Functions & Responsibilities
Quantitative Product Strategy & Roadmap
•
Define and maintain the product strategy and roadmap for quantitative investment capabilities, aligned with business priorities and the broader Investment Technology architecture.
•
Translate the distinct objectives of Quantitative groups into sequenced product themes, clear outcomes, and an appropriate balance of shared and strategy-specific capabilities.
•
Make evidence-based build, buy, reuse, adapt, and retire recommendations in partnership with investment teams, engineering, architecture, and Data & AI.
Workflow Discovery & Use-Case Development
•
Map end-to-end workflows across research, data acquisition, signal generation, scenario analysis, portfolio construction, execution support, monitoring, and performance feedback.
•
Develop well-structured use cases and product requirements covering the decision supported, users, data, value, risks, dependencies, controls, and adoption path.
•
Prioritize opportunities through the firm's intake process based on strategic alignment, value, scalability, technical and data readiness, risk, and organizational readiness.
Quantitative Domain Development
•
Shape products supporting returns forecasting, liquidity and cash-flow management, hedging and portfolio optimization, risk-adjusted asset allocation, predictive signals, portfolio construction, and monitoring.
•
Define requirements for scalable ingestion and use of private/public company, market, reference, alternative, portfolio, and third-party datasets.
•
Build connections between quantitative teams and the wider firm, enabling knowledge transfer, common standards, and greater reuse of institutional expertise.
Product Delivery, Adoption & Value
•
Champion a user-centric product approach, ensuring quant capabilities are designed around investor workflows and provide measurable improvements to investment decision-making.
•
Partner with Quantitative Engineering and other technology teams to move solutions from hypothesis and pilot into scalable, resilient, and maintainable products/services.
•
Establish adoption plans with business sponsors and define and track measures such as decision-cycle time, research throughput, model or component reuse, forecast quality, adoption, control effectiveness, and business value.
Governance, Partnership & Culture
•
Coordinate with Data & AI, architecture, cyber, infrastructure, risk, operations, legal, compliance, and vendor teams where products depend on shared platforms or require specialist review.
•
Represent quantitative product priorities in Investment Technology, Data & AI, and use-case governance forums, providing transparent rationale for roadmap and investment decisions.
•
Build trusted relationships with investment team members, quantitative engineers, risk professionals, and operations teams across regions.
Education & Qualifications:
•
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred. Quantitative discipline such as mathematics, statistics, engineering, computer science, economics, operations research, physics, or finance strongly preferred.
•
Relevant professional qualifications such as CFA, FRM, CQF, or equivalent are advantageous but not required.
Experience Required:
•
Demonstrated experience contributing to or owning products and platforms used by investment professionals for research, portfolio construction, risk, forecasting, execution support, or portfolio monitoring.
•
Strong product management capability across discovery, process design, roadmap development, prioritization, requirements, agile delivery, testing, launch, adoption, and measurement.
General Requirements:
•
5-8 years of relevant experience across product management, quantitative investing, investment technology, data products, business analysis, or quantitative engineering within an asset manager, alternative investment firm, investment bank, or financial technology organization.
•
Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to simplify complex quantitative topics for senior stakeholders and make clear recommendations under uncertainty.
•
High degree of ownership, judgment, curiosity, and comfort operating in an evolving global product organization and liaising with quantitative teams that have distinct objectives and working practices.
•
Collaborative and low-ego working style, with the confidence to challenge constructively and drive decisions across multidisciplinary teams.
Reporting Relationships
There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.

Onboarding flows and navigation

Who are we?
Howden is a global insurance group with employee ownership at its heart. Together, we have pushed the boundaries of insurance. We are united by a shared passion and no-limits mindset, and our strength lies in our ability to collaborate as a powerful international team comprised of 24,000 employees spanning over 56 countries.
People join Howden for many different reasons, but they stay for the same one: our culture. It’s what sets us apart, and the reason our employees have been turning down headhunters for years. Whatever your priorities – work / life balance, career progression, sustainability, volunteering – you’ll find like-minded people driving change at Howden.
Role Purpose
The Strategic Data & Analytics team builds the analytical products that support growth across Howden Employee Benefits. We are a business-embedded team that works directly alongside consultants, client directors and project teams, rather than operating within a traditional technology or IT function. Our products are used every day by colleagues across the UK business and by our clients to support better decision-making, solve complex challenges and deliver stronger outcomes.
This role keeps those products working and their users served, contributes to building the next ones, and owns how work moves through the team. You will be the first point of contact for users of our live products, you will own the backlog and the delivery and governance process, and you will build alongside the rest of the team on a defined set of firm-wide analytical products. Our approach is simple: build fewer things, build them fast, and build them once so they can be used many times.
It is also an unusually fast way to acquire breadth. You will work across Python, Shiny, Quarto, git, Azure DevOps, containerised deployment and infrastructure-as-code inside a single small team, on products with real users and a proper development lifecycle, rather than seeing one part of one stack. Where that leads is open. It may be deeper ownership of how our products run and scale, the build and engineering side of the team, or a direction of your own that we have not yet thought of. Howden is an entrepreneurial firm, and in this team growth happens in our daily work, not in an annual review.This is not a software engineering role and it is not an IT role. We are a consulting team that is proficient with technology.
Location is flexible, with home-based or local Howden office-based both available according to preference. The team itself is distributed across home and several Howden offices and works together primarily over Teams rather than in one room. Our closeness to the business is organisational rather than geographic.
Key Accountabilities
• Work directly with consultants and client directors, who are both our users and our route to the business.
• Support our live analytical products and the people who use them: triaging questions, requests and changes, resolving what you can, and scheduling the rest.
• Own the team’s delivery process: backlog management in Azure DevOps, change and release discipline, and running the governance and approval process on which delivery depends.
• Maintain the documentation, records and evidence that the team’s governance, reporting and assurance obligations require.
• Contribute to the build of new products and to the team’s reusable components, libraries and templates.
• Contribute to the development of the team’s internal delivery and deployment platform.
Skills & Experience
The first question is whether this is the right environment for you.
• You have a consulting mindset and enjoy working across a wide variety of problems.
• You enjoy helping colleagues and senior leaders make better decisions, and you see data, analytics and visualisation as your tools for bringing that about.
• You are the kind of person who finishes things, keeps records straight and does not let an unanswered request sit. The team’s ability to build depends on this role holding the process.
• You support the people around you, in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges. You share what you learn, you would rather have an honest conversation than a comfortable one, and you build your own network across the business. In a small team we succeed together, and nothing we build succeeds unless the business succeeds with it.
• You take ownership of your decisions, your actions and your outputs.
• You are comfortable with uncertainty and speed, and are interested rather than frustrated by new problems with incomplete and ambiguous information.
• You can work in a fast-growing firm where processes, systems and structures are still being brought together, and where parts of the environment are incomplete.
• You are effective in a distributed team. Most of our collaboration, with each other and with the business, happens over Teams, with colleagues you will meet in person occasionally rather than daily. If you do your best work by turning to the person beside you, this will be a difficult environment.
Technical experience:
• Evidence of analytical or data work that other people actually relied on.
• Experience of supporting users of something you or your team built, and of handling the requests and changes that follow.
• Experience maintaining documentation, governance processes and delivery records.
• Working experience of Python, and of some of the rest of our stack or close equivalents: Shiny or another interactive analytical UI framework, Quarto or similar reporting tooling, git, Azure DevOps or another pipeline and work-tracking platform. We expect some of these, not all, and a clear appetite to pick up the remainder quickly.
You must be able to build without AI coding agents. We do not use them for coding. You will read, write, debug and review code yourself, and be able to explain all of it. If any material part of how you work today depends on agent-assisted or “vibe” coding, this is not the role for you, and we would rather you knew that before applying.
Experience of Employee Benefits, Pensions or Insurance is not required.
What do we offer in return?
A career that you define. At Howden, we value diversity – there is no one Howden type. Instead, we’re looking for individuals who share the same values as us:
•
Our successes have all come from someone brave enough to try something new
•
We support each other in the small everyday moments and the bigger challenges
•
We are determined to make a positive difference at work and beyond
Reasonable adjustments
We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations at Howden to ensure that our positions align well with your needs.  Besides the usual adjustments such as software, IT, and office setups, we can also accommodate other changes such as flexible hours* or hybrid working*.

Thornton Tomasetti applies engineering and scientific principles to solve the world’s challenges. An independent organization of creative thinkers and innovative doers collaborating from offices worldwide, our mission is to bring our clients' ideas to life and, in the process, lay the groundwork for a better, more resilient future. Our Protective Design & Security practice prioritizes the protection of life and assets by mitigating consequences of security risks in the built environment. With more than 75 years of experience, our risk-led and strategic solutions safeguard people, property, and operations from intentional harm, evolving and emerging threats. Whether safeguarding a cultural landmark, securing a healthcare facility, or planning for crowd safety at a major event, our approach is grounded in intelligence, simulation, and human-centered design to deliver resilient solutions with demonstrable performance and lasting impact.
The Role
We are seeking a Project Engineer to join our growing Protective Design & Security practice. This is an opportunity to work on a diverse range of technically challenging projects across the UK and internationally. Our portfolio spans Government and defence, sport, commercial, rail, aviation, energy, critical infrastructure and other complex, high-profile sectors. You will deliver physical and electronic security projects, developing practical and innovative solutions that respond to the needs of our clients and the environments in which they operate.
As a Project Engineer, you will take ownership of projects, build strong relationships with clients and project partners, and support the development of less experienced engineers. You will have the opportunity to work independently while collaborating with colleagues across disciplines and offices to deliver high-quality outcomes on complex projects.
What You Will Do
• Deliver and manage security projects from inception through to completion including; developing and delivering security strategies, designs and technical specifications.
• Design and coordinate systems including access control, CCTV, intruder detection, intercoms and integrated security management systems.
• Work closely with clients, stakeholders, architects, engineers, contractors and other members of the project team.
• Coordinate designs using relevant digital tools, including Revit and AutoCAD.
• Apply appropriate security principles, guidance and standards, including relevant ISO and NPSA requirements.
• Support project planning, fee proposals, risk management and delivery.
• Review technical work and provide guidance to less experienced engineers.
• Mentor and support junior members of the team, contributing to their professional development.
• Represent Thornton Tomasetti professionally in client and project meetings.
• Maintain awareness of emerging technologies, standards and good practice in electronic security.
• Contribute to the continued development of the Electronic Security discipline within the PD&S practice.
What You Will Bring
You will have substantial experience in electronic security engineering or a closely related discipline, ideally more than five years, although no fixed experience threshold applies. You will be able to demonstrate sound technical judgement and the ability to take responsibility for projects and deliverables.
• Experience designing and delivering electronic security systems, ideally across complex or high-security environments.
• Experience leading and managing projects.
• The ability to collaborate positively within multidisciplinary teams.
• Strong written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills.
• Familiarity with, or a willingness to learn, Revit and AutoCAD.
• An understanding of relevant security standards, guidance and good practice, NPSA principles.
• A commitment to technical quality, continuous learning and professional development.
• Relevant qualifications or membership of an appropriate professional/industry body—such as the Security Institute or the Register of Security Engineers and Specialists—would be advantageous, but not essential.
Security Clearance
The successful candidate will be required to attain and maintain UK Government security clearance appropriate to the role and project requirements. Applicants must have been ordinarily resident in the UK for at least five of the last five years to meet the requirements for UK security clearance.
Applicants must also be legally permitted to work in the UK and will be required to provide appropriate evidence as part of the recruitment process.

Principal Modelling Engineer
Location
Manchester, UK
Department
Power Semiconductor R&D
About the Role
Nexperia is seeking an experienced Principal Modelling Engineer to join our Device Modelling team in Manchester.
In this role, you will be responsible for developing and advancing semiconductor device models for next-generation power semiconductor technologies. You will work closely with Device Engineering, Technology Development, Design, Characterization and Reliability teams to improve the understanding, prediction and optimization of device performance.
The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in semiconductor device physics, compact model development, parameter extraction methodologies and system simulation. This position focuses on enabling accurate device representation and performance prediction across a wide range of power semiconductor technologies.
What You Will Do
• Develop and maintain advanced semiconductor device models for power MOSFET and emerging power semiconductor technologies.
• Build compact device models using silicon characterization and simulation data.
• Perform device simulations to understand electrical, thermal and reliability behaviour.
• Drive model calibration, validation and correlation against measured silicon data.
• Collaborate with technology development teams to support new process generations and device architectures.
• Analyse device performance, switching behaviour and loss mechanisms.
• Support Design Enablement activities through accurate modelling methodologies.
• Contribute to the development of modelling flows, automation frameworks and best practices.
• Work closely with cross-functional R&D teams to evaluate design trade-offs and optimize device performance.
• Mentor junior engineers and provide technical leadership within modelling projects.
• Present technical findings to internal stakeholders and contribute to publications, patents and conference activities where appropriate.
What You Bring
Essential
• PhD or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Semiconductor Physics, or a related discipline.
• Extensive experience in semiconductor device modelling and simulation.
• Strong understanding of semiconductor device physics and power semiconductor technologies.
• Experience in compact model development and parameter extraction methodologies.
• Strong programming and data analysis skills using Python, MATLAB or similar tools.
• Experience correlating simulation results with experimental characterization data.
• Knowledge of system-level simulation techniques and model validation.
• Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary R&D environments.
Preferred
• Experience with power semiconductor devices, primarily Silicon (Si); experience with SiC and GaN technologies is also considered valuable.
• Knowledge of reliability modelling and semiconductor failure mechanisms.
• Experience supporting technology development or process integration projects.
• Familiarity with statistical analysis, Design of Experiments (DoE), and model optimization techniques.
• Track record of publications, patents, or conference presentations.
What We Offer
• Opportunity to work on industry-leading power semiconductor technologies.
• Collaboration with internationally recognized device and technology experts.
• Career development within a global semiconductor company.
• Competitive compensation and benefits package.

Excited to grow your career?
Are you looking for a career move that will put you at the heart of a global financial institution?  Then bring your skills and experience to Citi’s Internal Audit Strategy, Innovation & Professional Practices team.
By joining Citi you will become part of a global organisation whose mission is to serve as a trusted partner to our clients by responsibly providing financial services that enable growth and economic progress.
Our people make all the difference in our success.
Team/Role Overview
The Audit Director – Enterprise Resilience is a senior level management position, reporting to the Chief Auditor – Technology, Strategy & Governance, Emerging Technologies and Resilience, responsible for managing a team of audit professionals with an overall objective to strategically direct audit activities and assessments of the risk and control environment for Citi’s Enterprise Resilience. This covers the identification and mapping of critical and important business services, impact tolerance setting and testing, recovery and restoration capability, third-party and intragroup dependency management, and incident and crisis management.
This role will primarily focus on resilience across Citi’s global businesses and technology estate, with the overall objective of ensuring that Citi Internal Audit’s approach to resilience positions Citi IA as the leading IA function in the financial services industry.
Citi IA is a dynamic global function of over 2,500 professionals located across more than 60 countries, covering Citi’s global businesses and service to clients and customers through its network in 98 countries. Through a culture of continuous improvement, Citi IA is focused on maintaining its position as a best-in-class IA function and is committed to investing in people, learning and development, innovation, and methodology programs. The Internal Audit mission is to provide independent, objective, reliable, valued and timely assurance to the Board, senior management and regulators of Citigroup and Citibank (and its subsidiaries), over the effectiveness of culture, ethical conduct, governance, risk management, and controls that mitigate current and evolving risks and to enhance the control environment. IA is a change agent within Citi to enhance the control culture of Citigroup worldwide and therefore support senior management decision making around the globe.
Citi operates in over 100 countries and provides consumers, corporations, governments, and institutions with a broad range of financial services and products. Citi strives to create the best outcomes for clients and customers with financial ingenuity that leads to solutions that are simple, creative, and responsive.
