• Develop and maintain the Internal Audit resilience assurance strategy, ensuring coverage remains aligned to regulatory expectations, emerging risks and the firm's evolving technology landscape.
• Direct and oversee the end-to-end delivery of the Enterprise Resilience audit portfolio, ensuring all audits, thematic reviews, and continuous monitoring activities are executed with high quality, within approved budgets, and in compliance with IA methodology and professional standards.
• Act as a trusted subject matter expert on Enterprise Resilience risks and controls in financial services across the IA team.
• Partner with IA technology, cyber, third-party risk and business audit teams to scale resilience assurance across IA work programs and avoid duplicative coverage.
• Evaluate the identification of critical and important business services, the completeness and accuracy of end-to-end service mapping, and the substantiation of impact tolerances.
• Assess the design and execution of severe-but-plausible scenario testing, including the credibility of assumptions, the realism of test conditions, and the treatment of results that breach tolerance.
• Evaluate recovery and restoration capability, including disaster recovery architecture, failover and switchback testing, backup integrity, data recovery, and the ability to restore within stated tolerances.
• Assess the resilience of underlying infrastructure, including data centres, cloud platforms, network, capacity management and single points of failure, alongside concentration in providers and locations.
• Evaluate third-party and intragroup dependency management, covering criticality assessment, contractual protections, subcontracting and fourth-party visibility, exit planning and stressed exit, and substitutability.
• Assess incident and crisis management, including detection, escalation, invocation, command structures, regulatory notification, and post-incident learning.

• Champion horizon scanning for emerging resilience threats and for emerging methods and approaches in resilience risk management.
• Develop and retain talent in the resilience team, growing both their technical and risk management capabilities.
• Support and endorse the Quality Assurance (QA) function of IA, and resolve issues found by QA, improving audit processes and coverage
• Develop and maintain strong working relationships across other IA teams and relevant stakeholders.

Qualifications
• Strong track record leading operational resilience, technology risk, disaster recovery, cyber resilience, or third-party risk assurance programs within a global, systemically important financial institution (G-SIFI) or top-tier professional services firm.
• Strong knowledge of end-to-end resilience frameworks (IBS identification, end-to-end mapping, impact tolerances, severe-but-plausible scenario testing, and resilience metrics).
• Comprehensive understanding of modern enterprise architecture, including cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), microservices, API ecosystems, distributed databases, active-active topologies, and zero-trust security.
• Strong executive presence with a demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, challenge constructively, manage complex global issues and communicate effectively with Boards, senior management and regulators.
• Proven track record of building, leading and developing high-performing global teams, including talent management, succession planning and technical capability development.

As a Senior ROV Pilot Technician on a 12‑month fixed‑term contract, you’ll support the Supervisor in ensuring the safe and efficient operation and maintenance of Remotely Operated Vehicle (ROV) systems and all associated tooling. In this offshore position, you’ll pilot, maintain, and operate Work‑Class ROVs (WROVs) on a major subsea project in the Atlantic Ocean off the Spanish coast, contributing to a focused decommissioning campaign.

You’ll supervise shifts, communicate critical safety and operational updates, and manage team performance during offshore operations. You’ll also be proactive in identifying your own training needs and making the most of development opportunities throughout the contract period.
This is a hands‑on, safety‑focused position ideal for experienced professionals ready to lead by example in challenging offshore environments.
Your role and responsibilities
•
Maintain a strong safety focus with a proactive attitude toward Health, Safety, and the Environment, adhering to Fugro’s safety standards and core values.
•

The Senior Manager will serve as the senior technical accounting lead for high-value, non-standard European transactions and for evaluations of how new and evolving EU regulations affect contract structures, systems, and revenue recognition.
This is a highly visible, business-facing leadership role for someone who combines deep ASC 606 expertise with exceptional responsiveness, commercial judgment, and practical problem-solving. You will be expected to engage early, move quickly, communicate clear conclusions, workshop and brainstorm workable alternatives real-time, and maintain strong follow-through across urgent deal cycles and regulatory matters. This work supports timely deal execution, audit-ready conclusions, accurate revenue reporting, and scalable growth across a complex EMEA environment.

The primary responsibilities for this role include (but are not limited to):
• Serve as the senior technical revenue accounting lead for complex and judgmental EMEA transactions, including high-value, multi-country, highly negotiated, and precedent-setting arrangements.
• Lead accounting impact evaluations for new and evolving EU regulations, partnering closely with Legal and using documented legal conclusions to determine implications for revenue accounting and operational processes (billing, systems, controls, etc.).
• Identify and implement opportunities to use AI, automation, and standardized tools to accelerate regulatory research, contract review, issue tracking, and memo development without compromising judgment, documentation quality, or control rigor.

• Perform and review complex ASC 606 analyses and contract waterfalls across SaaS, usage-based, AI, hybrid cloud, professional services, reseller, and other evolving commercial models, including SSP, variable consideration, contract modifications, material rights, termination provisions, and principal-versus-agent considerations.

• Act as the primary escalation point for complex EMEA revenue matters; anticipate issues, communicate emerging risks early, and drive resolution without surprises across multiple countries and time zones.
• Present complex accounting positions and recommended paths forward to senior Finance and commercial leaders, external auditors, and outside advisors, and lead related audit discussions through resolution.
• Lead, coach, and review the contract revenue assessment and waterfall calculations of managers and other team members, strengthening technical judgment and consistency of execution.
• Support month-end and quarter-end close by ensuring complex EMEA transactions are assessed timely, accounting conclusions are complete, and calculations are complete and accurate.
Requirements
• Minimum of 7 years of relevant accounting experience, including at least 4 years in a people management or formal team leadership capacity, with hands-on software, SaaS, or technology industry experience.
• Deep expertise in ASC 606 and US GAAP, with demonstrated application to complex SaaS and enterprise arrangements and significant experience preparing and reviewing technical accounting memoranda.
• Recognized professional accounting qualification (e.g., ACA, ACCA, CPA, CA, or equivalent internationally recognized qualification) required.
• Demonstrated experience leading the accounting evaluation of complex, urgent, and highly negotiated transactions in partnership with Deal Desk, Legal, Sales, and Revenue Operations or Accounting teams.
• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesize complex facts, provide clear recommendations, and influence senior Finance and commercial stakeholders.
• Proven people leadership skills, including setting priorities, reviewing high-judgment work, coaching managers and individual contributors, and building accountability across a distributed team.
• Ability to operate independently with sound commercial and technical accounting judgment, attention to detail, and ability to re-prioritize as new items arise.
Desirable Skills
• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience; prior public accounting / Big 4 experience preferred.
• Experience with EU data, digital, AI, cloud sovereignty, consumer, or sector-specific regulations and their impact on commercial contracts or revenue recognition.
• Experience supporting multinational and cross-border SaaS transactions, including large enterprise or regulated-industry customers in EMEA.
• Experience with Salesforce, contract lifecycle management tools, Zuora RevPro, Workday, or similar revenue recognition and ERP systems, including systems integrations or migrations.
• Demonstrated experience with SOX controls, public-company audit readiness, and leading complex external audit consultations.
• Experience using AI-enabled tools, advanced Excel, or data tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of technical accounting processes.

Who we are
Microchip's Caldicot site is responsible for designing and delivering the next generation of advanced electronic module solutions for global technology markets. Our expertise lies in delivering advanced packaging solutions to our customers where small size and high reliability are critical. Some of our markets include medical, automotive, aerospace, and renewable energy. We develop a wide range of module solutions, ranging from miniaturized implant medical devices to compound semiconductor power modules.
We offer an attractive benefits package and flexible working arrangements. Microchip has a strong set of values and puts employee's continuous development and progression at its core. This position will allow you to become an integral part of a team of specialists in materials, mechanical, electronics and packaging engineers that strive to push the boundaries of conventional microelectronics packaging.  We are looking for an individual with a passion for exploration and breaking down barriers.  If you are a lateral thinker who thrives on challenging the norm, we welcome the opportunity to speak to you.

Main Duties and Responsibilities:
• Design and develop electrical layouts and schematics for Si and SiC power modules
• Perform electrical simulations to analyse circuit behaviour and optimize switching performance.
• Conduct electromagnetic field simulations to minimize parasitic effects and ensure compliance to target module specifications.
• Evaluate thermal performance in conjunction with electrical design
• Select components, including power semiconductors, passive components, and interconnects, to meet performance requirements.
• Optimize designs for electrical efficiency, reliability, and manufacturability.
• Support prototype builds and testing, analysing data to refine designs and improve performance.
• Prepare detailed technical documentation, including schematics, simulation reports, and test plans.
• Take on other engineering duties as required and assigned.
• Travel internationally on occasion as requested.
Requirements/Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field.
• 3+ years of experience in power module design, particularly with Si and SiC technologies.
• Proficiency in Altium Designer for electrical schematics and layouts.
• Experience with electrical simulation tools such as SPICE and PLECS.
• Experience of electromagnetic simulation tools, such as ANSYS Q3D, ANSYS Maxwell, and thermal analysis tools like ANSYS Icepak.
• Solid understanding of power semiconductor devices and loss mechanisms.
• Familiarity with reliability and quality standards for power modules.
• Strong problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a multidisciplinary team environment.

Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical subjects clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

A track record of turning research or infrastructure insights into product requirements, platform improvements, technical integrations, public technical content, or joint customer success.

The Role
Glamour is looking for a Lifestyle Content Creator & Writer to deliver relatable, entertaining and inspiring lifestyle content across the brand’s digital platforms. The role will be split across creating written copy for the site and video content for social.
The successful candidate will be brimming with story ideas and have a natural instinct for what our audience wants to read, watch and share. They will be an excellent writer with a distinctive voice, able to turn around clean, engaging copy in a fast-paced digital environment. They will be comfortable working under pressure to tight deadlines, highly collaborative and have a strong understanding of Glamour’s tone of voice and audience.
This role is a 12 month fixed-term contract and reports to the Digital Director, Glamour.
What will you be doing?
• Pitch 3–5 original web and social-first concepts daily, including formats and series for TikTok, Instagram and other platforms spanning beauty, wellness, culture and fashion, with a strong understanding of what makes content engaging, entertaining and shareable.

• Create ideas for short-form video, social series, explainers, interviews, reviews, tutorials, street-style content, challenges and other engaging formats; work closely with the social, video, SEO and commerce teams to develop ideas and translate lifestyle and beauty content across multiple platforms and formats.
• Co-ordinate and project manage the development and execution of editorial and social content ideas, series and franchises – liaising with social and video teams, editorial and stylists. Oversee social shoot production and post-production, and work with the social media manager on publishing and distributing content.
• Regularly appear in Glamour videos and create original on-camera and social content, bringing personality, expertise and authenticity to the brand.
• Support the Digital Director and Senior Editors in driving Glamour’s wider lifestyle and beauty content strategy.
• Stay ahead of emerging beauty and lifestyle trends, launches, creators, cultural shifts and consumer conversations to create fresh, relevant content that resonates with Glamour’s audience.
About you
• Experience producing social content and turning around editorial and social copy to tight daily deadlines.

• A keen eye for emerging trends, with the ability to pitch innovative stories that connect with a young, diverse readership.
• Basic knowledge of SEO best practices and social media strategies to maximise reach and engagement.
• A strategic thinker who understands the relationship between style and audience engagement.
• An understanding of Glamour’s voice, ethos and audience preferences.

Job Description:
Reports to
Division Controller, with functional alignment to the Segment IT Director (Specialty Products)
Team
Global Infrastructure, IT Operations & Cyber Manager; Data & Business Applications Lead; IT staff in Slovenia and China; MSPs in North America, UK, Italy, Bulgaria and New Zealand
About the role
ITW Appliance is a global manufacturing division of Illinois Tool Works, with 11 sites in 8 countries across Europe, North America, Asia and New Zealand. We are looking for a leader who can turn our data into a real business advantage and lead a lean, international IT organization.
We have already built a Microsoft Fabric data lake using a medallion architecture, with Power BI on top. Your first priority is to own this platform: direct and challenge its design, scale it across the business, and make sure the capability doesn't depend on any single person. You will also lead our ERP standardization on Acumatica.
A dedicated Infrastructure, Operations & Cyber Manager runs day-to-day infrastructure, cybersecurity and our MSPs, and reports to you. Your role there is to govern, prioritize and challenge, not to run it.
What you will own (in priority order)
1. Data platform and analytics
• Own the divisional data platform (Microsoft Fabric lakehouse, medallion layers, Power BI semantic models) and its roadmap.
• Set data architecture principles, data governance, data quality and a standard KPI framework across all sites.
• Direct pipelines and integrations built with Python, SQL and APIs, with enough technical depth to review and challenge design decisions.
• Deliver business use cases: demand forecasting (including machine learning), supply chain and purchasing visibility, and financial and operational KPIs.
• Coach and grow data talent, hire where needed, and keep the platform documented so there is a credible succession plan.
2. ERP and business applications
• Lead the Acumatica rollout and the retirement of legacy ERPs across sites, working with implementation partners.
• Make the ERP the single source of truth for master data and the main data source for the data platform.
3. IT leadership and governance
• Own the IT roadmap, budget and vendor strategy, using ITW's 80/20 approach to focus on what drives growth.
• Govern infrastructure, cyber and MSP performance through the Infrastructure & Cyber Manager, using clear SLAs.
• Lead a small team spread across Europe and Asia, with clear roles and accountability.
What we need from you
Must have
• You have personally designed and delivered a modern data platform (Microsoft Fabric, Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake or similar) with Power BI or an equivalent tool, not only sponsored one.
• Working knowledge of SQL and Python, and of API-based integration.
• Experience integrating ERP data in a manufacturing or industrial company (any mid-market or enterprise ERP, such as Acumatica, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, QAD or Oracle NetSuite).
• Experience leading people, including data specialists, and working directly with business leaders in operations, supply chain and finance.
• Around 10 years in data, BI or IT roles, with at least 5 in a leadership position.
• Fluent English.
Nice to have
• Acumatica or another mid-market cloud ERP.
• Multi-site or international manufacturing experience.
• Microsoft Fabric certifications (DP-600 or DP-700) or data management certification (DAMA CDMP).
• Machine learning for forecasting or planning.
This role is probably not for you if
• Your background is mainly infrastructure, cybersecurity, OT or IT operations.
• You have led data strategy only at sponsor level, without hands-on delivery.
• You are a developer or engineer who doesn't want to lead people and budgets.
What success looks like in the first 12 months
• The Fabric platform is documented and supported by more than one person, with a clear roadmap.
• Standard KPIs are used by division leadership and by all major sites.
• At least one business use case (forecasting or supply chain visibility) is live and delivering value.
• The Acumatica rollout plan is on track and the next sites are moving forward.
• IT roles, SLAs and MSP performance are clear and measured.
Why join us
You will have real ownership and visible impact in a lean division, with the backing of a global industrial group and a Segment IT network of peers across many manufacturing businesses. You will work with modern Microsoft data technology and see the results of your work directly in our plants.

UK 90-110k

The Power Station Integration team sits at the centre of our plant design, bringing together engineering disciplines to define how the full power station operates as one integrated system, ensuring performance, coherence and optimisation across an innovative and complex product. Location: Manchester & Birmingham
The Role
The Legal Support Assistant plays a key role in delivering high-quality administrative, operational and client service support to fee earners and legal teams. Acting as a trusted point of contact, you will manage a broad range of legal support activities, coordinate workflows, and ensure tasks are completed efficiently and to the highest standard.
Working collaboratively with Legal Support, Administrative Assistants and Document Production teams, you will maintain ownership of tasks from initiation through to completion, helping to drive exceptional service delivery for both internal and external clients.
Key Responsibilities
Client & Stakeholder Support
• Build strong working relationships with fee earners, clients and internal stakeholders.
• Act as a key point of contact for client and matter-related queries.
• Coordinate the production of legal documents, reviewing completed work for accuracy, formatting and consistency.
• Manage client communications, including telephone calls, emails, correspondence and message handling.
• Maintain client, contact and business development information within firm systems.
• Ensure compliance with client-specific protocols, processes and service requirements.
Administrative & Organisational Support
• Manage complex diaries, meetings, travel arrangements and associated logistics.
• Prepare agendas, meeting materials, presentations and reports.
• Support the opening and closing of matters, client onboarding and engagement documentation.
• Monitor key dates, deadlines and compliance requirements across matters.
• Produce and maintain spreadsheets, trackers and management information.
• Support business development activities, pitches, tenders and client events.
• Coordinate printing, scanning, document collation and courier arrangements when required.
Communication & Team Collaboration
• Manage incoming emails, correspondence and post, ensuring timely escalation and action.
• Draft routine correspondence and communications on behalf of fee earners.
• Collaborate effectively with colleagues across Legal Support, Business Services and legal practice groups.
• Attend meetings, take minutes and track actions to completion.
• Support team resourcing and provide cover during planned absences.
Financial & Matter Management
• Assist fee earners with billing and financial administration.
• Review time recording and disbursement allocations to ensure accuracy.
• Support Work in Progress (WIP) management and billing processes.
• Process expenses, payment requests and banking transactions in accordance with firm procedures.
• Assist with matter-related financial administration, including transfers and payment processing.
Matter & Data Management
• Maintain accurate client and matter information across firm systems.
• Create, update and manage electronic data rooms and document repositories.
• Undertake legal and regulatory searches and complete online submissions where required.
• Ensure compliance with firm policies, procedures and regulatory obligations.
• Manage workload effectively, prioritising competing deadlines and escalating issues where necessary.
What You'll Bring
Skills & Experience
• Previous experience within a legal or professional services environment.
• Strong client service focus with excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
• Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
• Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Ability to work independently, use initiative and take ownership of tasks.
• Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to delivering solutions.
• Professional, adaptable and collaborative approach to teamwork.
• High level of discretion and commitment to confidentiality.
Technical Skills
• Experience using document management and case management systems.
• Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
• Strong document production and formatting capability.
• Experience maintaining data integrity across multiple systems.
The Firm
When you work at Clyde & Co, you join a team of 500 partners, 2,400 lawyers, 3,200 legal professionals and 5,500 people in nearly 70 offices and associated offices worldwide. Our values are the principles that guide the decisions we make, unite us in our endeavours and strengthen our delivery, for both our clients and our firm. We work as one, excel with clients, celebrate difference and act boldly. We are committed to operating in a responsible way by progressing towards a diverse and inclusive workforce that reflects the communities and clients it serves. We are devoted to providing an environment in which everyone can realise their potential, using its legal and professional skills to support its communities. We do this through pro bono work, volunteering and charitable partnerships, and minimising the impact it has on the environment, including through our commitment to the SBTi Net-Zero standard and the setting of ambitious emissions reduction targets.
Our Commitment
Clyde & Co is proud to be an equal opportunities employer. Our values encourage us to support fairness, celebrate diversity and prohibit all forms of discrimination in the workplace to allow everyone to excel at work. Therefore, we welcome and encourage all applications from suitably qualified individuals, regardless of background or identity. Learn more about our interview process.
A Note on Privacy
Please take a moment to read our privacy notice. This describes what personal information Clyde & Co (we) may hold about you, what it’s used for, how it’s obtained, your rights and how to contact us as a data subject.
If you are submitting a candidate as a Recruitment Agency Partner, it is an essential requirement and your responsibility to ensure that candidates applying to Clyde & Co are aware of this privacy notice.
This is the job description as constituted at present; however, Clyde & Co reserves the right to reasonably amend it in accordance with the changing needs of the business.

cloudimperiumgames.wd503.myworkdayjobs.c.description_excerpt:
We are a crowdfunded company and have a dedicated and enthusiastic community of backers who are helping us create the “Best Damn Space Sim Ever”. We want to build the best we can deliver and we believe wholeheartedly in the value of exceptional diverse talent.
Design Director
Cloud Imperium Games is looking for a talented Design Director to be responsible for leading the Design Vision for Star Citizen and/or Squadron 42 in our Manchester studio.
Founded in 2012, Cloud Imperium Games creates cutting-edge videogames that defy expectations. We’re currently developing Star Citizen, a record breaking multiplayer online space sim, and Squadron 42, cinematic single-player adventure set in the same universe. Join us as we break boundaries and make videogame history.
For more information about life at Cloud Imperium Games, check this out - https://youtu.be/cXjp7SRBpIA
About the role:
This role requires a dedicated and dynamic individual with previous experience in systems design, both hands-on and as a leader. As a creative, the Design Director will guide the Systems Design teams and collaborates with Game and Creative direction to provide both inspiration and high-level direction for new experiences that complement the established themes, settings, and gameplay systems of the project. As an architect, the design Director ensures that content is built to standards and works to define reliable workflows within the framework of existing game systems. As a team leader the Design Director builds and curates a professional cohort that takes initiative, drives innovation, communicates clearly and executes development with care and distinction.
What does a Design Director at CIG do?
• Work alongside the other directors and the Senior Game Director to maintain the high standards of Design needs for Star Citizen and Squadron 42.
• Develop new approaches to Systems Design that push the boundaries of the Star Citizen universe.
• Hire, mentor and manage senior members of the Design Team, helping them to refine their skills, move along their career paths and bu8ild up the teams under them.
• Guide the team through priority changes and gameplay iteration, updating goals and maintaining focus and team morale.
• Collaborate with other departments including sound, artists, UI/UX and engineers to ensure a great player experience
• Work directly with production to ensure that schedules and plans meet business and project needs.
What do we expect from our Design Director?
• A proven background in a Design Leadership position and shipped AAA content.
• Capability to build and grow a highly effective creative team through all stages of development.
• Experience in identifying technical and developmental risks and obstacles, creating innovative solutions to overcome them while promoting new and innovative ways of working.
• Ability to create and optimize design pipelines and workflows.
Diversity Statement
CIG is a global company, staunchly committed to cultivating a culture and workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, lifestyles, and perspectives. Together, we are creating a space where authentic recognition, appreciation, and understanding of the importance of diversity is fostered by everyone. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we strive to build a team that represents all walks of life, and we want every employee to bring all the things that make them unique to the work environment. The universe is as vast and varied as the people in it, and it’s our differences that make it special.
Fraud Statement
We are aware of people receiving job offers that fraudulently allege to be from CIG. These types of fraud can be carried out through false websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal info like bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money for the purchase of business equipment.
If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities, as well as reaching out to us at info[@]cloudimperiumgames.com with any information you may have.
If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us!

Job Description
Head of Insights
So, who are we?
IG Group is a FTSE 100 fintech operating across five continents, serving over 1.4m customers and handling billions of dollars in transactions – built on scale, trust, and proof. We didn't pivot to innovation; it's how we've always operated. Your Team:
This role reports into the Marketing & Growth Director and sits on the Marketing & Growth Leadership Team, working alongside Brand & Product Marketing, Content, PR & Public Affairs and Creative. You'll also partner closely with Performance, Product, Commercial and Operations, ensuring customer insight informs decisions well beyond marketing activity. You act as the insight engine for the function, translating complex data into clear, compelling narratives that help stakeholders understand what is working, why, and what to do next.
Your role in the Team’s Success:
IG Consumer is looking for a sharp, commercially minded Insight Lead to sit at the heart of our Marketing & Growth function.  You'll shape how we understand our customers and hold a seat at the Marketing & Growth Leadership Team, using data, research, and competitive intelligence to drive smarter, faster decisions across campaigns, brand, product, commercial and operations.
You'll be expected to run research and analysis yourself as well as set the strategic agenda, translating complex questions from senior stakeholders into a clear insight plan and delivering the answers personally.
What you’ll do:
Strategy & stakeholder leadership
• Be the voice of the customer on the Marketing & Growth leadership team, contributing an insight-led perspective to strategic planning, campaign prioritisation, and commercial decision-making
• Own the Insights roadmap, partnering closely with Product, Commercial and Operations leadership to ensure insight informs operational decisions, not just marketing activity.
• Act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders, constructively challenging with data and translating ambiguous business questions into a clear insight agenda and actionable recommendations.
• Define and own the future shape of the Insights function – team structure, capability, hiring, with accountability for developing into senior insight practitioners
Consumer & behavioural insight
• Design and execute primary research programmes (quantitative and qualitative), ensuring they are methodologically robust, to develop a deep understanding of IG's existing and prospective customers, their motivations, behaviours, and unmet needs.
• Partner with Head of Data & Analytics to analyse behavioural data to uncover trends, patterns, and actionable insights that inform marketing strategy and campaign planning
• Lead the development of self-service tools which allow stakeholders to remain consistently informed
Competitive & market intelligence
• Monitor the competitive landscape, tracking competitor positioning, messaging, product developments, and marketing activity.
• Synthesise market intelligence into clear strategic briefings that help senior stakeholders understand the external environment and identify opportunities.
Performance insight & reporting
• Partner with Head of Brand, PR and Content to evaluate marketing performance, going beyond surface-level metrics to surface the 'so what' behind the numbers.
• Develop and iterate a scalable reporting framework that enables consistent, data-driven decisions across the function.
Insight capability & vendor management
• Champion a culture of insight-led decision making across Marketing & Growth, proactively identifying opportunities where data and research can add value.
• Manage relationships with external research vendors and platforms (e.g. Qualtrics), ensuring quality outputs and value for money.
What You'll Need:
• Experience leading insight strategy at a senior stakeholder or leadership team level
• Strong analytical skills with hands-on experience using data analytics software like SPSS, Python or Askia
• Demonstrable experience designing and running primary research programmes using platforms such as Qualtrics
• Proven ability to synthesise multiple data sources — quantitative, qualitative, and competitive — into cohesive, actionable strategic insight.
• Passionate about customers and believe the best commercial decisions begin with meaningful insight
• You build trusted relationships and influence stakeholders across different functions and levels of seniority
• Experience partnering across Marketing, Product, and Operations functions to embed insight into decisions beyond marketing.
• Commercially minded with a genuine curiosity about consumer behaviour and what drives performance across multiple markets.
• Experience integrating AI in workflows or an interest in learning how to do so
Desirable
• Experience working in fintech, financial services, or another regulated, performance-driven sector.
• Experience working both agency side and in an house insight team
• Experience building or evolving an insight capability from the ground up, including introducing new tools, processes, or frameworks.
• Knowledge of data privacy regulations (e.g. GDPR) and their implications for research and analytics.

It really is more than a job. We think like a start-up, but we deliver like a FTSE 100 — so the bar is high, and we won't pretend otherwise. We work hybrid, which means three days in the office. We’ll recognise your talent and make sure that you can still have a life – at work, and outside of it. Networks, committees, awards, sports and social clubs, mentorships, volunteering opportunities, extra time off… the list goes on.

Month-end close and reporting

Controls and compliance

Closing Date: 4th November 2026 (COB)
Business Introduction
We manufacture and supply reliable, high-quality medicines and vaccines to meet patients’ needs and drive our performance.
Our network of 37 medicines and vaccines manufacturing sites delivered 1.7 billion packs of medicines and 409 million vaccine doses in 2024 to help make a positive impact on the health of millions of people. Our supply chain is not just core to our operations; it’s vital to bringing our innovations to patients as quickly, efficiently and effectively as possible. Technology is transforming how we manufacture medicines and vaccines, enabling us to increase the speed, quality and scale of product supply.
We need the very best minds and capability to help us on our journey to make more complex products, harnessing the power of smart manufacturing technologies including robotics, digital solutions and artificial intelligence to deliver for patients.
Position Summary
The Packaging Material and Equipment Technologist will provide hands-on technical delivery for packaging activities within the Worthing Site Packaging Project. Reporting to the Packaging Technology Project Lead, the role will assess and implement primary, secondary and tertiary packaging materials; define and execute trials; support material and equipment qualification and validation; complete technical risk assessments; and create or update specifications, drawings and artwork inputs through formal change control. A central requirement is to understand how material properties, pack design and print or coding requirements interact with forming, sealing, handling, inspection and cartoning equipment so that solutions are robust, compliant and capable at production scale. The role will work through a cross-functional matrix with MSAT, Engineering, Operations, Quality, Regulatory, Artwork Packaging Services, Supply Chain and external material and equipment suppliers.
Responsibilities
This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. These responsibilities include some of the following:
• Deliver packaging material and equipment activities: Plan and complete assigned material, component and equipment-interface activities for primary, secondary and tertiary packaging, from development and approval through line introduction and routine manufacture, maintaining clear evidence and escalating risks or dependencies.
• Assess material–equipment interactions: Evaluate how material properties, tolerances, pack design and print or coding requirements affect forming, sealing, feeding, handling, coding, vision inspection and cartoning; define appropriate machine settings, operating ranges and controls.
• Plan trials and deliver validation: Develop and execute trial, qualification and validation protocols for packaging materials, pack formats and equipment interfaces, including objectives, sampling plans and acceptance criteria; analyse results, resolve deviations and document evidence-based conclusions.
• Manage technical risk and problem solving: Lead or contribute to technical risk assessments, FMEA, transit assessments where applicable; troubleshoot performance issues, support root-cause investigations and translate identified risks into proportionate controls, test plans and corrective actions.
• Maintain specifications, artwork and technical documentation: Create, review and update component specifications, drawings, artwork briefs, master data, protocols, reports and change-control records, ensuring alignment with approved pack requirements, market needs, GMP and regulatory expectations and maintaining inspection-ready traceability.
• Coordinate technical interfaces and suppliers: Work cross-functionally and with material, component and equipment suppliers to resolve technical questions, confirm capability, obtain supporting evidence and ensure proposed solutions are compatible with site equipment, processes and project commitments.
Key Skills and Experience Required
• Relevant technical background: Degree-level qualification, or strong equivalent experience, in packaging, materials science, engineering or another relevant scientific or technical discipline, supported by practical experience in a pharmaceutical or similarly regulated environment.
• Packaging materials and equipment-interface expertise: Knowledge of primary, secondary and tertiary packaging materials, component manufacture and printing techniques, with a strong understanding of how material properties and tolerances influence forming, sealing, feeding, coding, online artwork printing, inspection, handling and line performance.
• Qualification, validation and technical trials: Demonstrated experience planning, executing, analysing and reporting material, process or equipment trials, qualification and validation using scientifically sound, risk-based approaches.
• Risk assessment and evidence-based problem solving: Experience applying Quality by Design, FMEA, root-cause analysis and technical risk assessment, with the ability to interpret trial and production data, identify trends or failure modes and convert evidence into practical controls and recommendations.
• Specifications, artwork and compliance: Experience creating or updating packaging specifications, technical drawings, artwork inputs and controlled records through formal change control, underpinned by good working knowledge of GMP, data integrity, product quality and regulatory requirements.
• Project delivery, collaboration and communication: Well-organised delivery within a complex technical or capital project, with clear technical writing, effective stakeholder communication, cross-functional collaboration, supplier management through influence, resilience and a hands-on approach to resolving issues and meeting commitments.
Location:
- This role is site-based at our Worthing GSK manufacturing facility in the United Kingdom.
About Worthing Manufacturing Site:
Manufacturing at the Worthing site is for antibiotics (Penicillin). It is advised that you take this into consideration when deciding to apply for this position.
GSK Worthing Site is a mixed manufacturing site with complex regulatory pressures. Manufacturing processes are highly technical and include high hazard activities.
What success looks like
- Robust packaging designs and documented qualifications that support reliable supply.
- Smooth handover of packaging changes into routine operations with minimal disruption.
- Timely resolution of packaging issues and strong supplier partnerships.
- Clear, concise technical documentation that supports manufacturing and audits.

Job Description Summary
GE Vernova's Rotating Machines Rugby operation builds some of the most technically demanding equipment in defence, aerospace, and industrial power. When a product leaves our facility, it must perform — and the integrity of that performance starts here, on the shop floor.
This is a senior technical leadership position at the heart of a low-volume, high-complexity manufacturing environment where bespoke engineering and exacting safety-critical standards define everything we do.
As Lead Quality Assurance Engineer, you will serve as the primary technical authority for manufacturing quality within the RMR Quality team. This is not a process-administration role, you will provide hands-on operational leadership on the shop floor, drive the transition from reactive issue management to proactive defect prevention, and hold firm accountability for the quality integrity of high-value, bespoke equipment.
You will be the operational anchor for the Quality function — the person who determines when our processes are truly production-ready, and who sets the standard for technical rigour across Manufacturing, Engineering, and Project Management.
If you are an experienced quality leader ready for genuine technical ownership in a mission-critical engineering environment, we want to hear from you. You must also be a sole British citizen (hold a valid UK passport) with the ability to obtain UK security clearance to SC-level.
Job Description
Operational Quality Leadership
• Direct daily Quality Engineering and inspection activities, aligning resource prioritisation with manufacturing schedules, customer commitments, and safety-critical compliance requirements
• Act as the primary operational authority for the Quality function, interfacing directly with Manufacturing, Engineering, and Project Management to resolve technical bottlenecks
• Lead daily operational reviews, monitor workload and technical risk, and ensure clear escalation of issues that threaten quality integrity
Quality Engineering & Non-Conformance Management
• Provide hands-on leadership for NCR management, ensuring all investigations, dispositions, and corrective actions are technically sound and fully supported by empirical evidence

• Enforce strict accountability for CAPA effectiveness across all functional owners, eliminating repeat defects through process-based solutions
Quality Performance & Continuous Improvement
• Manage operational performance through advanced trend analysis (Pareto, defect rates, Cost of Poor Quality), translating data into targeted improvement initiatives
• Champion the development and maintenance of manufacturing Control Plans and PFMEAs, working with Engineering to improve process capability and reduce variability across complex production lines
• Facilitate structured improvement projects using Lean/Six Sigma methodologies to enhance quality systems, inspection efficiency, and digital process controls
Quality Governance & Cross-Functional Alignment
• Ensure full compliance with ISO/AS9100 standards and customer specifications, maintaining the integrity of all quality records, inspection evidence, and non-conformance documentation
• Lead operational preparation for internal, customer, and regulatory audits, ensuring follow-up actions are closed with technical rigour
• Maintain clear functional boundaries, ensuring the Quality team provides expert assurance and technical support without diluting the accountability of Manufacturing and Engineering
What You Will Bring
Essential
• Proven technical leadership in a complex, highly regulated manufacturing environment — aerospace, defence, power generation, or a comparable bespoke engineering sector
• Deep expertise in NCR management, structured root cause analysis (8D, Ishikawa), and CAPA effectiveness verification
• Practical experience applying PFMEA, Control Plans, and APQP including PPAP
• Strong technical literacy: ability to interpret complex engineering drawings, tolerances, GD&T, and detailed technical specifications
• Demonstrated experience using SAP and digital QMS systems for quality data management and reporting
• Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills — able to translate complex technical quality issues into clear, actionable language for both technical and non-technical audiences
• Proven ability to coach, develop and upskill quality and production teams, embedding a culture of continuous improvement and quality ownership at every level
• Strong MS PowerPoint and Excel skills for analysis, reporting and presenting quality performance data to senior stakeholders
• You must also be a sole British citizen (hold a valid UK passport) with the ability to obtain UK security clearance to SC-level.
Desirable
• Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher, with a demonstrable track record of measurable process improvements
• Experience in high-complexity sectors such as rotating electrical machines or heavy engineering
• Experience leading customer-facing inspections, audits, and formal product documentation (e.g., AS9102 First Article Inspection)
• Familiarity with statistical process capability analysis (Cpk/Ppk) in manufacturing environments

• Income protection and life assurance

Join Creative Assembly and craft deep and detailed games that last, entertaining millions of players across the globe for decades.
The Role
Creative Assembly is looking for a Franchise Design Director who will be accountable for developing the expertise of the Total War design discipline, the design craft and methodologies, and the franchise design strategy.  You'll oversee all aspects of the design teams across Total War: how we think about design, and how we deliver player value, excitement and joy. Player value is our principle that everything we make has to be worth our players' time, and you'll champion it in every design strategy.  You will take a long-term view of how we grow design expertise, grounded in player feedback and data-informed creativity.
What you’ll be doing
On a day-to-day basis, you will:
1. Design discipline management
•
Organising the discipline management structure to provide quality people management (hiring, onboarding, 1:1s, career development, clear communication and escalation paths, motivation, performance management, feedback, helping with project placement/allocation in collaboration with Resource Managers etc.)
•
Building a formal design capability pathway: a competency framework, career progression and an onboarding programme, so every designer has a clear route to expert level whichever discipline they came from
•
Owning the design hiring bar: role profiles, interview design and calibration, and building CA's reputation as a destination for world-class design talent
•
Design craft & methodologies (establishing and maintaining standards, continuous improvement process)
•
Collaborates with:
•
HR, Resource Managers
•
Product Team Leads (Producers* and Product Owners), Discipline Team Leads
2. Support and development of Project Creative Directors
•
Provides communication line between Franchise Leadership Team and Project teams on a frequent basis
•
Craft leadership and support: holding the agreed goals and direction, coaching Creative Directors on design craft, and adapting quickly when needed
•
Design Craft support
•
Collaborates with:
•
(Project Leadership) Producers & Creative Directors, (Stream Aligned Teams) Product Owners & sub-discipline leads
•
Franchise Leadership Team, Head of Product
3. General Franchise Design - Analysis & R&D
•
Exploration and analysis of the existing and evolving design of the Total War franchise
•
Create and maintain a franchise design vision and philosophy that matches our franchise vision.
•
Seeks opportunities and areas for improvement or advancement
•
Defining what Total War design is and turning it into teachable material the discipline can be formally trained against
•
Collaborates with:
•
Product, Brand & Player research
•
Use your experience to promote our company values and culture, keep the working environment positive and inclusive, provide mentoring and coaching, and build high-performing teams.
•
You will be responsible for the overall Design strategy
•
You'll work with your Franchise Leadership Team colleagues on the internal and external strategy for the design discipline and the wider business
•
Anticipate and solve problems, on your own and with senior leadership. Get clarity and decisions quickly, step in to build consensus, and agree a way forward.

Essential
•
Multiple shipped titles, including at least one shipped in a design leadership role (Lead, Principal, Design Director or equivalent)
•
A proven track record of growing designers. You've built and run structured development for a design team, whether that's competency frameworks, career progression, onboarding or mentoring, and you can show what changed as a result
•
Experience developing designers who came into design from other disciplines, and a clear view of how to build formal training that makes good instincts repeatable and teachable

A track record of raising a hiring bar: you have designed and calibrated interview processes for design roles and attracted senior design talent to a studio

Demonstrate a passion for all things game design and a keen interest in games development overall
•
You have broad knowledge of games across platforms and genres, and an ongoing desire to learn about the craft. You play everything
•
You have a strong understanding of player motivation and what makes gamers tick
•
You treat design as a craft that is both art and science — something that can be understood, taught and improved, and you apply that knowledge and curiosity to any genre you work in.
•
You have a clear, well-articulated design philosophy and can explain how it shapes your practice.
•
You are constantly up to date on trends in the games industry and in entertainment more broadly
•
You play analytically. You can explain why a game works, not just whether you liked it, and you can build deep knowledge of the Total War series quickly.

An interest in history
•
Attention to detail and a passion for making quality products
•
Self-motivated, focused, and consistently delivers high-quality work
•
A strong communicator who writes clearly and succinctly
•
A constructive approach to complex problem solving and teamwork

You have a high quality bar and a need to drive excellence in your craft and in the work of those around you. When something isn’t good enough, you can coach, mentor, and explain why that’s so.

You can drive consensus and navigate teams to the best outcomes. You always work to build bridges, and you let the best idea win regardless of where it came from.

Accountability is critical for yourself and others. You demonstrate accountability and you require it of others around you.

As part of the United Infrastructure Group, we are a dynamic and innovative specialist engineering services, solutions and products provider focused on servicing our clients’ immediate and future needs. We do this through the development of industry-changing cleantech products as well as through engineering delivery excellence.
We specialise in the design and delivery of process, mechanical, electrical and ICA engineering-based projects, products and solutions. Regardless of the project, they all pursue the same goal: to improve the efficiency and sustainability of our water, wastewater and waste treatment.
We have a team of highly skilled and experienced professionals with extensive consulting and contracting experience, including engineers, scientists and commercial managers. Our knowledge and expertise spans more than 30 years, across industries including: water, wastewater, marine, energy and power sectors. Our aim is simple – to provide the most effective solutions and products on the market and thus, exceed clients expectations through market-leading technology. From technical through to commercial and management expertise, we have the in-house expertise to execute a range of projects from the most basic to highly complex.
Job title | Electrician
Location | Site based role covering Norfolk/Suffolk
About us
AFECO is an engineering services provider, delivering high quality process and MEICA design and installation projects across the UK for the water industry. We have an excellent inhouse engineering teams capable of delivering all stages of the project cycle, from concept through to commissioning, with a strong focus on process led innovative and robust yet appropriate solutions.
We have a portfolio of varied projects covering both wastewater and clean water projects, covering planned and reactive projects.
Due to the expansion of our team, we are currently recruiting for site-based electricians to work as part of our multi-disciplinary team. This is a great opportunity for enthusiastic individuals who fit in with our company values and are keen to develop in a forward-thinking organisation.
Role overview
As a member of our multi-skilled and mobile site team, you will be responsible for the on-site installation, testing and sign-off of our projects. You will be enthusiastic and keen to solve problems and assist in the delivery of our projects in a manner that exceeds our customers’ expectations and ensures that our work adheres to the Company’s management systems including all occupational health and safety (OH&S), environmental and quality policies and requirements.

•
Carry out electrical installation and refurbishment works on existing water company sites in accordance with the project requirements and programme.
•
Work on client sites across the region – you may be required to work away from home and stay overnight during the week subject to the project location and in accordance with the project needs. You may be required to undertake paid overtime as required.

Inspect, survey, identify faults, carry out works and test electrical systems.

Observe and comply with all good working practices.

Capable of working at heights and in confined spaces in industrial environments.

We are looking for people who share our passion and willingness to deliver an excellent service safely. If you are dedicated with a positive attitude, then we want to hear from you! We are looking for the following qualifications and attributes:

2+ years’ related experience post qualification in electrical installation and testing, preferably in the UK water sector

ECS Gold card or can easily obtain one

EUSR clean water card (preferable)

Emergency first aid or First Aider (preferable)

Able to work well in a team and give as well as take instruction

Punctuality and reliability

Excellent health and safety knowledge and application

Willingness to learn and undertake training as required

Positive “can do” attitude with flexible approach to work and ability to work on own initiative
Working Conditions

Job Description
Job Title: Project Controls Manager
Location: Glasgow, Scotland
Overview:
The Project Controls Manager is responsible for the continuous measurement, analysis, control, forecasting and reporting of project cost, cash and revenues.  Monitoring and recording changes and the implementation of aligned project specific strategies for cost control. Take a lead on major projects, responsible for all the financial aspects of a project and ensuring the financial information aligns to the latest project schedule.
What will you do?
Key Areas of Responsibility (KARs):
Controlling
• Developing detailed Projects Cost Structures and coding under the Standard Work Breakdown Structures for various project types and reflect it in the ERP and relevant systems. To be closely mapped to the schedule activities for easier tracking
• Monitoring closely all project's activities and tasks, that drives the project progress, by challenging the Project team on the strategies to achieve them, and communicate the finding to the reporting team
• Provide critical assessment of all budgets and cost projections, and find initiatives to optimize extra cost and develop effective strategies and recovery plans to bring cost in line with budget
• Identifying trends and quantifying cost variances, collecting and recording trends and reflecting the approved trend impacts in the project forecast
• Build and implement the early warning indicators within the project, and communicate them to the project team and management, to take preemptive actions to mitigate any potential losses
• Deploying earned value management in line with Linxon strategy
• Guides project team to analyze, evaluate, and forecast project costs, as well as performance against an established schedule with critical milestones.
• To develop and implement cost control technique and methods, and making detailed plans to accomplish goals and directing the integration of activities.
• Supervise and monitor the work of the local and offshore Project Controllers.
Reporting
• Prepare together with the PM’s and reporting team the core of the monthly budget reporting i.e. executive update, Progress curves, cost status, Manpower Plan, Risk analysis, Cash and Revenue, and lead the project review session with the PM
• Analyse the Purchase Orders against the forecasts, and take action on the Estimate to Complete to complete balance, if any, along with a phasing plan
• Accurately phase out all the work packages of the project, and monitor the progress regularly
• Record and report the physical progress achieved on all activities, along with supporting documents, to reflect the accurate position of the project
• Provide the necessary support to the Country controller for the preparation of position papers
• Supporting resource load planning and scheduling
• Assisting project management to develop and enforce lessons learned within the company
Collaboration
• To Support tendering activities with detailed cost estimates and cashflows, along with consideration of scope and contractual obligations.
• Build collaboration with the management as well as internal and external partners
• Working closely with the full project team, Project Management, Engineering, and Construction/site team, while working transversally with the Finance teams to improve the efficiency of the common tasks and requests.
• Transitioning of project from tender to the execution team, by conducting a full handover session to go through the contractual and technical details of the project, before signing off
• Participate in and contribute to risk and opportunities assessments.
• Supporting contract management and the project manager on claims and change orders and other contractual obligations such as bank guarantees.
Commercial
• Ensure adherence to the change management protocols, with respect to the administration of variations and claims toward the client and subcontractors.
• Understand the commercial aspects of the contract, and review the major supplier purchase order commitments, addressing any potential claims, or change orders.
Cash
• Maintenance of positive project cashflows at all times, and find solutions with the project manager to mitigate any reduction in the cashflow
• Ensure all customer invoices are submitted on time, with regular follow-up for collection
• Ensure the hedging file currencies are aligned with the project purchase orders and phasing plan
General
• Apply and ensure application of standards and procedures set by Linxon.
• Liaising with the client, representing Linxon at a high standard
• Adhere to all safety, health, and environmental rules and regulations
• Contributing to Linxon worldwide development, assisting other regions to build a strong knowledge networking
Technical skills and qualifications:
• Financial Bachelor or Master with relevant Project Controller experience
• Extensive year’s of experience as a project controller in Engineering, procurement, and construction management
• Subject matter expert in project costing, estimating, cost control functions and change control
• Experienced in Planning and Forecasting
• Experienced in Risk Management
• Experienced in Earned value management
• Knowledge of Performance management
• Great knowledge of time-related analysis
• Excellent computer literacy with experience in Planning and Cost control Standard tools and software
• Experience in Invoicing & Handling Bonds
• Experience in reading & understanding contract documents
• Fluent command on English Language and the native language of the country to be based on
